paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama4 Scout (top) and Llama4 Maverick (bottom) on 5-digit multiplication.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy of two models, Llama4 Scout and Llama4 Maverick, on 5-digit multiplication tasks as a function of initial confidence, with the x-axis representing "Initial Confidence" on a linear scale ranging from 0.91 to 0.98 and the y-axis showing "Accuracy" on a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0. The data for Llama4 Scout is represented by a blue solid line with circular markers, which shows a relatively high accuracy, starting at approximately 0.85 when initial confidence is 0.91 and peaking at around 1.0 near an initial confidence of 0.92, before slightly declining and stabilizing near 1.0. The data for Llama4 Maverick is shown by an orange dashed line with diamond markers, which begins at an accuracy of about 0.65 at an initial confidence of 0.91, increases to a peak of approximately 0.92 at 0.92, and then steadily decreases to about 0.08 at an initial confidence of 0.98. A third set of data, represented by a green dotted line with square markers, shows an accuracy that starts at around 0.2, dips to approximately 0.06 at 0.92, then increases to about 0.22 at 0.94, and continues to rise to roughly 0.9 at 0.98. Error bars are present for all data points, indicating variability in the measurements.
